summary: The historical holdout was inspected during exploratory auditing and is not a pristine blind test.

accesses.scope: The single MAT container was loaded and aggregate holdout statistics were computed, including RMS/support diagnostics and a preliminary memory-polynomial PA fidelity score.
One normalized maximum of holdout x and CSV line counts were inspected during read-only design/review. No DPD cascade or formal holdout performance metric was computed.

impact.reason: Human exploratory access can influence later decisions even when the formal selector is code-isolated.

remediation: Freeze every remaining model and protocol choice without further holdout access.
Use the current holdout only as a disclosed historical evaluation split.
Obtain a new untouched capture for a genuinely blind final evaluation.
Use a physical PA or queryable black box to measure the response to new predistorted input.
